hindi: जनमेजय ने कहा:
english: Janamejaya said:

words.gloss: Triviṣṭapa, the heaven of the gods

hindi: मेरे पूर्वपितामह पाण्डव और धार्तराष्ट्र त्रिविष्टप स्वर्ग को प्राप्त करके किन-किन स्थानों को प्राप्त हुए?
english: Having reached heaven, Triviṣṭapa, which abodes did my forefathers, the Pāṇḍavas and the sons of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, obtain?
notes: triviṣṭapa (lit. 'the triple summit') is taken as a name of heaven in apposition to svargam.

hindi: यह मैं सुनना चाहता हूँ; मेरे मत में तुम सर्वज्ञ हो, और अद्भुत कर्म करने वाले महर्षि व्यास से तुम अनुज्ञात हो।
english: This I wish to hear; you are all-knowing, in my view, and you have been authorised by the great sage Vyāsa of wondrous deeds.

hindi: वैशम्पायन ने कहा:
english: Vaiśampāyana said:

words.gloss: Triviṣṭapa, the heaven of the gods

hindi: तुम्हारे पूर्वपितामह युधिष्ठिर आदि त्रिविष्टप स्वर्ग को प्राप्त करके जो कुछ किया, वह सुनो।
english: Hear what your forefathers, Yudhiṣṭhira and the others, did after reaching heaven, Triviṣṭapa.

words.gloss: Triviṣṭapa, the heaven of the gods

hindi: धर्मराज युधिष्ठिर ने त्रिविष्टप स्वर्ग में पहुँचकर दुर्योधन को श्री से सम्पन्न, एक आसन पर बैठा हुआ देखा,
english: Having reached heaven, Triviṣṭapa, Dharmarāja Yudhiṣṭhira saw Duryodhana, endowed with splendour, seated on a seat,
notes: The sentence continues in verse 5 (further description of Duryodhana).

words.gloss: with the Sādhyas (a class of gods)

hindi: जो सूर्य के समान देदीप्यमान था, वीर-लक्ष्मी से घिरा हुआ था, और तेजस्वी देवताओं तथा पुण्यकर्मा साध्यों के साथ विराजमान था।
english: shining like the sun, enveloped in the glory of heroes, in the company of radiant gods and the Sādhyas of meritorious deeds.
notes: Continues the sentence of verse 4; all accusatives qualify duryodhanam. puṇyakarmabhiḥ is taken with sādhyaiḥ (and devaiḥ).

hindi: तब युधिष्ठिर दुर्योधन को देखकर क्रुद्ध हो उठे और सुयोधन में वह श्री देखकर सहसा पीछे मुड़ गए,
english: Then Yudhiṣṭhira, having seen Duryodhana, grew indignant, and seeing the splendour upon Suyodhana he at once turned back,
notes: Suyodhana is another name of Duryodhana (both names occur in this verse). The sentence continues in verse 7 (bruvan).

hindi: और उनसे ऊँचे स्वर में यह वचन कहा: "लोभी और अदूरदर्शी दुर्योधन के साथ रहकर मैं लोकों की कामना नहीं करता,
english: saying loudly to them these words: "I do not desire the worlds together with Duryodhana, the greedy and short-sighted one,
notes: The '~' in lokā~l stands for the anunāsika of the sandhi lokān + lubdhena (lokām̐l); not a typo. tān ('to them') refers to the gods and others present. The speech runs to verse 10.

words.gram: ind. (rel. pron. + loc. sg. of kṛta)

hindi: जिसके कारण सारी पृथ्वी, मित्र और बन्धु-बान्धव भी, पहले महावन में क्लेश पाए हुए हम लोगों के द्वारा युद्ध में बलपूर्वक मारे गए;
english: on whose account the whole earth, friends and kinsmen alike, were slain by us by force in battle, we who had earlier suffered in the great forest;
notes: hatā (f. sg.) agrees with pṛthivī sarvā; the merged sandhi hatā + asmābhiḥ requires the singular (hatāḥ + asmābhiḥ would stay 'hatā asmābhiḥ'); suhṛdaḥ and bāndhavāḥ are carried along by the first subject. kliṣṭaiḥ qualifies asmābhiḥ.

words.gloss: in the midst of the assembly hall
in the presence of the elders

hindi: और जिसके कारण धर्म का आचरण करने वाली, निर्दोष अंगों वाली हमारी पत्नी पांचाली द्रौपदी सभा के बीच गुरुजनों के समक्ष क्लेश को प्राप्त हुई।
english: and on whose account Draupadī, the princess of Pāñcāla, who walks in dharma, our wife of faultless limbs, was tormented in the midst of the assembly hall in the presence of the elders.

hindi: हे देवताओ, आपका कल्याण हो! सुयोधन को देखने की मुझे कोई इच्छा नहीं है। मैं वहाँ जाना चाहता हूँ जहाँ मेरे वे भाई हैं।"
english: Farewell, O gods; I have no wish to look upon Suyodhana. I wish to go there where those brothers of mine are."
notes: svasti here is a parting blessing ('be well, farewell').
lines_deva: स्वस्ति देवा न मे कामः सुयोधनमुदीक्षितुम्
तत्राहं गन्तुमिच्छामि यत्र ते भ्रातरो मम
lines_iast: svasti devā na me kāmaḥ suyodhanamudīkṣitum
tatrāhaṃ gantumicchāmi yatra te bhrātaro mama

words.gram: m. nom. sg., pres. part. pra-√has

hindi: "ऐसा मत कहो" — यह बात नारद ने मानो हँसते हुए उनसे कही — "हे राजेन्द्र, यह स्वर्ग का निवास है; यहाँ वैर-विरोध भी नष्ट हो जाता है।
english: "Not so!" said Nārada to him, laughing as it were. "O lord of kings, this is a dwelling in heaven; here even enmity perishes.
notes: mā evam = 'not thus', i.e. do not speak or act so. viruddham taken as a noun ('hostility'); it could also mean 'what is contrary'. 'this is' / 'here' (यह ... है / यहाँ) are supplied: literally 'dwelling in heaven, O lord of kings; even enmity perishes', i.e. for one dwelling in heaven enmity ceases.
lines_deva: स्वर्गे निवासो राजेन्द्र विरुद्धं चापि नश्यति
lines_iast: svarge nivāso rājendra viruddhaṃ cāpi naśyati

hindi: हे महाबाहु युधिष्ठिर, राजा दुर्योधन के विषय में किसी भी प्रकार ऐसा मत कहो, और मेरा यह वचन सुनो।
english: O mighty-armed Yudhiṣṭhira, do not speak thus in any way regarding King Duryodhana; and hear this word of mine.
lines_deva: दुर्योधनं प्रति नृपं शृणु चेदं वचो मम
lines_iast: duryodhanaṃ prati nṛpaṃ śṛṇu cedaṃ vaco mama

hindi: यह राजा दुर्योधन देवताओं के साथ-साथ उन सज्जनों और श्रेष्ठ राजाओं द्वारा पूजित होता है जो ये स्वर्गवासी हैं।
english: This King Duryodhana is honoured, together with the thirty gods, by the good and by the foremost kings, these who dwell in heaven.
notes: Alternative: 'is honoured by the thirty gods together with the good and foremost kings' (tridaśaiḥ as agent rather than companions). sadbhiḥ may also qualify rājapravaraiḥ ('by the good foremost kings') instead of being a separate noun.
lines_deva: एष दुर्योधनो राजा पूज्यते त्रिदशैः सह
lines_iast: eṣa duryodhano rājā pūjyate tridaśaiḥ saha

words.gloss: the goal of the world of heroes

hindi: उसने युद्ध में अपना शरीर होम कर वीरलोक की गति प्राप्त की है — उसने, जिसने युद्ध में देवताओं के समान तुम सब लोगों का सामना किया था।
english: He attained the goal of the world of heroes, having offered his own body in battle — he by whom all of you, equal to gods, were confronted in battle.
notes: samāsitāḥ: taken as 'faced, withstood' (sam-ās 'to sit against, confront'); the exact derivation is uncertain.
lines_deva: यूयं सर्वे सुरसमा येन युद्धे समासिताः
lines_iast: yūyaṃ sarve surasamā yena yuddhe samāsitāḥ

words.gloss: by the dharma of a kṣatriya

words.gram: m. nom. sg., past act. part. ava-√āp

hindi: इसी ने क्षत्रिय-धर्म के द्वारा यह स्थान प्राप्त किया है; वह पृथ्वीपति महान भय में निर्भय रहा।
english: This very one obtained this place through the dharma of a kṣatriya; that lord of the earth remained fearless in great danger.

hindi: हे पुत्र, जूए के कारण जो हुआ, उसे मन में नहीं रखना चाहिए; और द्रौपदी के क्लेश का भी तुम्हें चिन्तन नहीं करना चाहिए।
english: What was brought about by the dicing, son, should not be kept in mind; nor should you dwell on the torment of Draupadī.

text_flags.why: possible typo: the infinitive of cintayati is cintayitum; 'cintayatum' is not a regular form (metre is the same either way)

hindi: और जूए के कारण, युद्धों में अथवा अन्यत्र तुम लोगों को जो अन्य क्लेश भी हुए, उन्हें भी तुम्हें स्मरण नहीं करना चाहिए।
english: And whatever other torments of yours there were, caused by the dicing, in battles or elsewhere — you should not recall them.

hindi: हे मनुजाधिप, राजा दुर्योधन से यथोचित रीति से मिलो; यह स्वर्ग है, यहाँ वैर नहीं होते।"
english: Meet King Duryodhana as is proper; this is heaven, O lord of men, here there are no enmities."

hindi: नारद के द्वारा इस प्रकार कहे जाने पर बुद्धिमान कुरुराज युधिष्ठिर ने अपने भाइयों के विषय में पूछा और यह वचन कहा।
english: Thus addressed by Nārada, the wise Kuru king Yudhiṣṭhira asked about his brothers and spoke these words:
notes: bhrātṝn papraccha: 'asked after his brothers' (the brothers are the object asked about, as the following verses show).

words.gram: m. gen. sg., tat-puruṣa with negation

words.gloss: injurer of the earth and of friends

hindi: "यदि धर्म को न जानने वाले, पापी, पृथ्वी और सुहृदों से द्रोह करने वाले दुर्योधन के ये वीरलोक सनातन हैं,
english: "If these worlds of heroes are eternal for Duryodhana, the wicked one ignorant of dharma, the injurer of the earth and of friends,
notes: pṛthivīsuhṛdadruhaḥ: the extra 'a' after suhṛd is taken as the epic a-stem form suhṛda- before druh; alternative reading 'injurer of the earth's well-wishers' (pṛthivī-suhṛd as one member). Sentence continues to verse 23.

words.gram: ind. (rel. pron. + loc. sg. of kṛta)
m. nom. pl., desid. adj. prati-√kṛ

hindi: जिसके कारण घोड़ों, रथों और हाथियों सहित पृथ्वी नष्ट हो गई, और हम भी क्रोध से दग्ध होकर वैर का बदला लेने की इच्छा वाले हो गए —
english: on whose account the earth with its horses, chariots and elephants was destroyed, and we too, burnt by wrath, became bent on requiting the enmity —
lines_deva: वयं च मन्युना दग्धा वैरं प्रतिचिकीर्षवः
lines_iast: vayaṃ ca manyunā dagdhā vairaṃ praticikīrṣavaḥ

hindi: तो वे वीर, महात्मा, महाव्रती, सत्यप्रतिज्ञ, संसार के शूरवीर और सत्यवादी मेरे भाई —
english: then those heroes, my great-souled brothers of great vows, true to their promises, the champions of the world, truthful in speech —
notes: lokasya śūrāḥ: 'the brave ones of the world', i.e. renowned among people.
lines_deva: ये ते वीरा महात्मानो भ्रातरो मे महाव्रताः
lines_iast: ye te vīrā mahātmāno bhrātaro me mahāvratāḥ

hindi: तो उनके अब कौन-से लोक हैं? मैं उन्हें देखना चाहता हूँ; और महात्मा, सत्यप्रतिज्ञ कुन्तीपुत्र कर्ण को भी,
english: which worlds are theirs now? I wish to see them, and the great-souled Karṇa, son of Kuntī, true to his word,
notes: The accusatives from karṇam onwards (through verse 26) all depend on draṣṭum icchāmi.

words.gloss: by the dharma of a kṣatriya

hindi: धृष्टद्युम्न और सात्यकि को, धृष्टद्युम्न के पुत्रों को, और उन राजाओं को भी जो क्षत्रिय-धर्म के अनुसार शस्त्रों से मृत्यु को प्राप्त हुए।
english: Dhṛṣṭadyumna and Sātyaki, and the sons of Dhṛṣṭadyumna, and those kings who met death by weapons in accordance with the dharma of a kṣatriya.
lines_deva: ये च शस्त्रैर्वधं प्राप्ताः क्षत्रधर्मेण पार्थिवाः
lines_iast: ye ca śastrairvadhaṃ prāptāḥ kṣatradharmeṇa pārthivāḥ

hindi: हे ब्रह्मन्, वे राजा कहाँ हैं? हे नारद, मैं इन्हें नहीं देख रहा हूँ — विराट और द्रुपद को, तथा धृष्टकेतु आदि उन राजाओं को,
english: Where are those kings, O brahmin? I do not see these, Nārada — Virāṭa and Drupada, and those headed by Dhṛṣṭaketu,
lines_deva: क्व नु ते पार्थिवा ब्रह्मन्नैतान्पश्यामि नारद
lines_iast: kva nu te pārthivā brahmannaitānpaśyāmi nārada

hindi: पांचाल के शिखण्डी को, द्रौपदी के सभी पुत्रों को, और दुर्धर्ष अभिमन्यु को भी — हे नारद, मैं इन्हें देखना चाहता हूँ।"
english: and Śikhaṇḍin of Pāñcāla, all the sons of Draupadī, and the unassailable Abhimanyu — I wish to see them, Nārada."
